name: qumi-depot-bridge
description: Portable QUMI internal engineering plugin: Depot CLI discovery and verified agent-local installation, SDK/MCP build tools, secure operator credential rotation, non-secret Git receipts.

interface.longDescription: QUMI Depot Bridge by Mohammed Mansour for Qumi Teknolojis, trading name of QROO Inc. (https://qumi.app; https://qr-oo.com; support@qr-oo.com). Installable by Codex/Claude and Depot-hosted agents. Ships a zero-dependency local MCP server to expose CLI detection, SHA-256 verified Depot CLI installation into user or project scope, discovery of all supported CLI subcommands, guarded execution, build SDK operations when separately installed, and optional operator-configured upstream MCP. Secrets must never be entered in chat or MCP form mode. The operator-only hidden terminal encrypts tokens with AES-256-GCM and a passphrase; an unlocked agent process can use them in memory, including GIT_ASKPASS. Rotation produces a non-secret encrypted-ciphertext fingerprint receipt optionally committed to Git. Windows DPAPI remains supported. A ChatGPT web connection requires a separately hosted verified HTTPS MCP endpoint; packaging alone does not deploy one.
defaultPrompt: Inspect QUMI Depot builds through the MCP SDK bridge and return failing step logs, IDs, and evidence links.
Show the installed Depot CLI command catalog and inspect a subcommand before execution.
Diagnose the Windows VHost MCP connection and report missing credentials securely.
